# BroadwayCloudPubSub v1.0.0 - Table of Contents

> A Google Cloud Pub/Sub connector for Broadway

## Pages

- [BroadwayCloudPubSub](https://broadway-cloud-pub-sub.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://broadway-cloud-pub-sub.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [BroadwayCloudPubSub.Client](https://broadway-cloud-pub-sub.hexdocs.pm/BroadwayCloudPubSub.Client.md): A generic behaviour to implement Pub/Sub Clients for `BroadwayCloudPubSub.Producer`.
- [BroadwayCloudPubSub.Producer](https://broadway-cloud-pub-sub.hexdocs.pm/BroadwayCloudPubSub.Producer.md): A GenStage producer that continuously receives messages from a Google Cloud Pub/Sub
topic and acknowledges them after being successfully processed.
- [BroadwayCloudPubSub.PullClient](https://broadway-cloud-pub-sub.hexdocs.pm/BroadwayCloudPubSub.PullClient.md): A subscriptions [pull client](https://cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.subscriptions/pull) built on `Finch`.
